testcase.name: Upload through the existing material pipeline (`/api/courses/materials/add` and the host importer), so the file is retained, its text and images are available to the tutor, and the learner can view it.
The material is marked as graded work in its title or locator so the library shows it as such.
The tutor reads each question's mark and feedback and proposes which course skill it shows and how well.
The tutor request sends the retained file (PDF or images) inline as the other kinds do, so handwriting and marks in photos can be read.
The learner checks and edits the mapping, then confirms.
Skills without evidence keep their estimates.

`fresh` is true (new problems); `gateMet` is false (an import cannot show the complete demonstration gate); `performedAt` is the date the learner entered; `mark` and `feedback` are the original grader's.
The original marks are stored unchanged and shown as the grader gave them.
Each confirmed question becomes an imported assessment case whose judgment updates that skill's mastery as of the performance date.
The `sourceKey` identifies the material, question, and skill, so a repeat confirm is refused by the concept rather than duplicated.
The performance date is required and may not be after today.
At least one row must be mapped to a skill to confirm.
A result of INDEPENDENT is allowed only when the learner declared no help; otherwise the strongest result is SUPPORTED.
the proposed skill (one of the course's confirmed skills, or none)
Recommendation: keep it out of lessons; it is evidence, not course material.
Corrections use the existing regrade and manual-correction flow.
Every endpoint checks the session, course ownership, and that the material belongs to the learner and course.
Another learner's imports are never visible.
Show the starting basis and the provisional sentence from `basis` prominently when there is no scored evidence yet
The timeline shows every change the concept reports, in order, with readable dates ("Fri, Oct 23") and rounded values; nothing is computed in the browser that the concept already computes.
The skill page shows the adjustment in the timeline and the new estimate.
`adjust` takes an operation key so a retry adds no second row
Several attachments: each attached photo is listed in the sent message
Several attachments: the server refuses an attachment that is not the learner's own material, as today
Opening a source shows the text at the cited location and names the file and location as the labels do today ("Lecture 4 · Page 1").
If the location is an image, show the image.
Every new endpoint checks the session and ownership; another learner cannot adjust or read another's estimate.
